fields.title: Crop suitability, class index (Global - 20 years average - ~10 km) - GAEZ v5
fields.notes:
Crop suitability results are presented as an index, calculated for all land area and classified into categories, on grids with a spatial resolution of approximately 10 km. Estimations account for respectively rain-fed and irrigated conditions, different time periods, as well as two different levels of inputs and management (high and low). Results are provided for more than 70 major crops including traditional and adapted crops in alignment with the Vision for Adapted Crops and Soils (VACS) [(see Appendix 4-1 of the GAEZ v5 Model Documentation)](https://github.com/un-fao/gaezv5/wiki/14.-Appendix-4%E2%80%901-Crops), and cover all land and soil groups identified in the Harmonized World Soil Database (HWSD v2) (FAO & IIASA, 2023).

The crop suitability index represents the weighted sum of extents in different suitability classes, expressing the suitability make up of a grid cell as a number in the range of 0 to 100. The index results in a value of 100 when all land in a location is assessed as very suitable (VS) and in a value 0 when all land is not suitable (NS).

Crop suitability index is estimated using different climate data sources for both historical and future periods.
Historical climate data is sourced from AgERA5 from the Copernicus program, covering the periods 1981–2000 and 2001–2020.
For future projections, climate model outputs from the latest CMIP6 IPCC AR6 are used, based on three Shared Socioeconomic Pathways (SSPs) and spanning four time periods: 2021–2040, 2041–2060, 2061–2080, and 2081–2100.

This dataset is part of the GAEZ v5 Suitability and Attainable Yield theme and Suitability Class sub-theme.

For additional information on the data contained in this dataset, please see the [(readme file)](https://data.apps.fao.org/catalog/dataset/514c92d5-9e01-4c70-814a-80ea1ca9fe6a/resource/768b08ad-be9c-427a-84be-3a3d6dd7835a/download/_readme_res05.xlsx). For more detail on the GAEZ v5 methodology, please refer to the GAEZ v5 Model Documentation (accessible at https://github.com/un-fao/gaezv5/wiki).



	
**Data publication:** 2025-03-24
	



**Supplemental Information:**

No data value: 0

Unit : Class

Scale Factor : 1.0

Map code : RES05-SIX

Class - Caption

1 - SI > 85 : Very high

2 - SI > 70 : High

3 - SI > 55 : Good

4 - SI > 40 : Medium

5 - SI > 25 : Moderate

6 - SI > 10 : Marginal

7 - SI > 0 : Very marginal

8 - Not suitable

9 - Water

Theme: Suitability and Attainable Yield

Sub-theme: Suitability Class

Variable Name: Crop suitability index in classes; all land in grid cell

**Data lineage:**

All results are derived from the Agro-ecological Zones (AEZ) modeling framework, developed collaboratively by the Food and Agriculture Organization (FAO) and the International Institute for Applied Systems Analysis (IIASA). The complete methodology is detailed in the Global Agro-ecological Zones v5 – Model Documentation, available at https://github.com/un-fao/gaezv5/wiki
